items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: Landing page — 5–10 days. Corporate site — from 3 weeks. Online store with integrations — from 4 weeks. Exact deadlines go into the contract after the brief.

items.question: We already have a site and a CRM, but they don't talk. Is that your job?
items.answer: Yes, that's our core work. We don't rebuild everything from scratch — we connect what already runs: site, CRM, accounting, marketplaces, telephony, shipping.

items.question: Why more expensive than a freelancer?
items.answer: Because the price includes a contract, a 12-month warranty, configured analytics and support. A freelancer is cheaper right up until they disappear — then you pay twice for the same thing.

items.question: What does post-launch support include?
items.answer: First month — free fixes and consulting. After that, by agreement. We don't disappear once we're paid.

items.question: Do you hand over access?
items.answer: Yes, all of it, immediately. Site, domain, hosting, analytics — they're yours. We don't hold clients hostage.

items.question: Do you work with existing sites?
items.answer: Yes, that's most of our work. We take a site in any condition — extend it, fix it, integrate it with everything else.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. For larger projects — staged, with each stage's deliverable fixed in the contract. The next payment only comes after you've accepted the previous stage. We don't ask for money for the next step until the current one is closed.

items.question: What if I need something non-standard?
items.answer: Message us on Telegram and we'll talk it through. We've built integrations with Vapi, Binotel, SalesDrive, KeyCRM, Checkbox and Nova Poshta. Chances are we've done it already.

hero.subtitle: Chatbots for your website and Instagram, voice agents for calls, CRM automation. Customers get answers in seconds, orders land in your CRM hands-free, no call goes missed.
trust: We work with KeyCRM, SalesDrive, accounting systems
Timeline and budget fixed in the contract

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.subtitle: The most common reasons businesses come to us for automation
items: A lead comes in at 11:40 PM — the reply goes out at 9:30 AM. The customer already bought from whoever answered first
A manager copies orders into the CRM by hand. Every day, an hour or two
Half of support's day is the same questions: “how much”, “where is my order”, “is it in stock”
Nobody calls back missed calls. Nobody even knows how many there were
Another order-processing manager is 25,000+ UAH a month — and they still need training
You've heard AI “delivers results”, but where to start in your business is unclear
answers: A chatbot replies in seconds at any hour — not with templates, but from your catalog, prices and stock
Orders from the website, Instagram and Telegram land in your CRM with every field filled — no manual copying
A voice agent calls back missed calls, confirms orders and sends payment reminders
We start with a free audit: we show you the 2-3 places where automation pays off fastest

items.question: How much does a website chatbot cost?
items.answer: From 30,000 UAH end to end: scenarios, catalog and CRM integration, training on your data. The exact price depends on channels and integrations — we quote it after a free audit.

items.question: What can a voice AI bot do?
items.answer: Take a call or make one: confirm an order, answer common questions, remind about payment — and log the result in your CRM. It speaks natural Ukrainian and hands complex conversations to a human.

items.question: Will a bot replace my manager?
items.answer: No — it removes the routine: common questions, order confirmations, copying data into the CRM. Managers sell instead of copy-pasting.

items.question: Which CRMs and services do you work with?
items.answer: KeyCRM, SalesDrive, accounting systems, OpenCart, Horoshop, Nova Poshta, Binotel, Checkbox — and any system with an API.

items.question: Where do we start with AI in my business?
items.answer: With a free audit: we look at your processes and show the 2-3 places where automation pays off fastest. No strings attached.

items.question: How fast will I see results?
items.answer: Depends on scope: a simple chatbot takes weeks, not months. The exact timeline is fixed in the contract after the audit; payment is per accepted stage.
